info.name: SMC Trade License - End to End (TL_NEW / TTL_NEW)
info.description:
End-to-end test of the Sangamner Municipal Council trade license on UPYOG.

Order: 00 Login → 01 Setup (once) → 02 Pre-checks → 03 Upload → 04/05 lifecycle → 06 Draft → 07 Negative tests.
Each request saves what the next one needs (tokens, application, bill). Read the Test Results tab after each request.

Set before running: baseUrl, citizenMobile/citizenOtp, the Username/Password of each employee role, propertyId (a pg.smc property with no dues).
Employee roles: cfc = TL_CEMP, clerk = TL_DOC_VERIFIER + TL_FIELD_INSPECTOR, hod = TL_HOD, co = TL_APPROVER, admin = SUPERUSER.

exec: // fresh owner/partner mobile + Aadhaar per run (user service creates the owners as users)
const rnd = (first, len) => first + Array.from({ length: len - 1 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)).join('');

request.description: Sends the login OTP to citizenMobile.
Set citizenOtp first (the SMS OTP, or the fixed OTP of a test environment).
Employee login. Set cfcUsername / cfcPassword in the collection variables. Saves cfcToken and cfcUserInfo.
Employee login. Set clerkUsername / clerkPassword in the collection variables. Saves clerkToken and clerkUserInfo.
Employee login. Set hodUsername / hodPassword in the collection variables. Saves hodToken and hodUserInfo.
Employee login. Set coUsername / coPassword in the collection variables. Saves coToken and coUserInfo.
Employee login. Set adminUsername / adminPassword in the collection variables. Saves adminToken and adminUserInfo.
Sangamner 8-step workflow for the Permanent license. Run once.
Same workflow for the Temporary license. Run once.
The slabs are loaded with billingslab_TL_SMC_Annexure1.sql. Expected 52 PERMANENT + 53 TEMPORARY.
Saves the first locality code of the city in localityCode (used by the Permanent license).

exec: const walk = (x, out) => { (Array.isArray(x) ? x : [x]).forEach(n => { if (!n) return; if (Array.isArray(n)) return walk(n, out); if ((n.label || '').toLowerCase() === 'locality') out.push(n); walk(n.children, out); }); return out; };

Payment: { tenantId: lic.tenantId, totalDue: amount, totalAmountPaid: amount, paymentMode: 'CASH', paidBy: 'OWNER', payerName: owner.name, mobileNumber: owner.mobileNumber,
paymentDetails: [{ businessService: 'TL', billId: pm.collectionVariables.get('billId'), totalDue: amount, totalAmountPaid: amount }] } };

request.description: TL_NEW is always PERMANENT.
Permanent needs IMMOVABLE.*
All 6 documents are mandatory.
Property tax number is mandatory for Permanent.
At least one land identifier is required.
Partnership needs the trade owner and at least one partner.
Area must be > 0.
Temporary needs MOVABLE.*
